data.title: Payment reminder (Mahnung) for returned direct debit – November gym membership fee
data.summary: MusterFit Studios GmbH is demanding €47.40 (the €39.90 November membership fee plus a €7.50 reminder fee) after the direct debit for the November 2025 membership fee was returned by the bank, to be paid by 12 December 2025.
data.explanation: Your gym's direct debit for November could not be collected, so they added a €7.50 fee for the returned payment (Rücklastschrift) on top of the €39.90 membership fee. Pay the total of €47.40 to the stated account by the deadline shown, quoting your membership number if possible. If you already paid around this time, the letter says you can treat it as settled. If you ignore it, further reminder fees or collection steps could follow, though none are stated here.
